title: feat(sync-in): a job pulls a mapping's datasourceSource — the federated object is read in windows into the synced target (ADR-0153 D1, D2, D8)
body:
Part of #32062

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches `connectorSource` or `datasourceSource` today (`git grep` over `skills/` finds neither); the hand-written guide this change made false, `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` ("Pulling a mapping"), is corrected in this PR, and the sync-in guide and skills are ADR-0153's P3 guide + skills child

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把第一片的分窗读取器接上 `job.pull`。带 `datasourceSource` 的映射现在会被作业调度，每次运行按窗读取联邦对象，并写入 `synced` 目标对象。拉取结果的契约 `ConnectorSourcePullResult` 增加 `source` 判别字段（连接器 / 数据源两臂）。另外修了评审的 S1 和 N3。
- 为什么改：ADR-0153 D1/D2 的读取器上一片没有调用者，补救文案指向的路径也走不通（评审 N1）；席位在 6774801890 把这些定为第二片。
- 风险与回滚：多了一个实际运行的数据路径，但只作用于声明了 `datasourceSource` 的映射。读取位置要等 `sys_sync_run` 才持久化，在那之前每次都从 `watermark.start` 重读，靠按键 upsert 保证幂等。在隔离 / 集团租户姿态下，源对象没声明组织范围就拒绝拉取，不会跨组织复制。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-pull.ts`（`organizationScope` 和读取前的校验）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`（判别联合）、`datasource-window-read.ts` 的 `commitWindow` 与 `judgeBounds`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/datasource-pull.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全绿，含隔离姿态下只复制本组织行的用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约面需要席位安排 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 评审）。

## What changes

Slice 2 of the sync-in P2 engine, in the order the seat restated in 6774801890: the windowed reader of slice 1 (#32275) is wired to `job.pull`.

- **The pull of a `datasourceSource`** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-pull.ts`, dispatched from `pullConnectorSource`, so both sources answer the one contract method). It judges the binding against the objects as the protocol serves them, then reads the federated object in windows and writes through `runImport` in `upsert` mode, as the connector pull does. The judgments, with the build's own tokens where the ADR has one:
  - the target is `managedBy: 'synced'` (`mapping_target_refused`);
  - the source is federated (`external`) and lives on a non-managed datasource (`source_binding_invalid`);
  - its `columnMap` maps a column onto `id` (`source_key_missing`);
  - the window field is a `datetime`, `date` or `scale: 0` number (`source_binding_invalid`);
  - a `fieldMapping` entry copies it unchanged onto a target field of its type (`watermark_field_unmapped`).

  This covers carrier note 6762989212 item 2: a stack the build never judged is judged at run time.
- **Read path** from the datasource definition, with the floor's own predicate (`needsExternalDriverFloor`). Every read names its `limit`:
  - a built-in page asks for the smaller of 1,000 and the deployment's maximum page size or row budget;
  - a floored window asks for the datasource's row cap (`resolveExternalRowCap`, now exported from `@objectstack/objectql`).

  So the data door's default page size (`OS_DATA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`) never cuts a window, and a deployment whose maximum page is below the cap is refused by the door, loudly.
- **D8's read half — beyond the seat's slice list, see the report.** Under a walled posture, every read carries `organization_id = <the job's organization>` when the source declares its own `organization_id`. A shared source (`tenancy: { enabled: false }` / `systemFields: { tenant: false }`) is read whole. A source that states no scope is refused (`source_organization_scope_unstated`), and so is a walled source pulled in no organization (`job_organization_missing`). The scope is read by plugin-security's `externalOrganizationScopeOf`, the one reading the organization wall and its boot refusal use. That moves `@objectstack/plugin-security` from a dev dependency to a runtime dependency of service-automation (no cycle: plugin-security depends on neither service-automation nor its dependents). Without this half, a wired pull would read a walled federated object as the system with no organization predicate and copy every organization's rows into the job's organization.
- **No committed position yet.** It is stored on `sys_sync_run` (D7, after #32073). Until then every run reads from `watermark.start`, and the result reports the position the run would commit. `datasourceSource.full` therefore changes nothing yet and stays `planned`.
- **Contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, a `contracts/` piggyback per seat answer 1). `ConnectorSourcePullResult` becomes `ConnectorSourcePullConnectorResult | ConnectorSourcePullDatasourceResult`, told apart by `source`:
  - the connector arm keeps `connector` and `action` required and `source` optional, read as `'connector'`, so an implementation that answers the old shape still compiles;
  - the datasource arm carries `object`, `datasource`, `readPath` and `watermark: { field, from, committed? }`.

  The regenerated `api-surface/contracts.json` shows the interface became a type alias plus three interfaces.
- **The binder** (`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`): `judgeJobPull` binds either source, and its no-source refusal names both keys. `pullRunOutcomeOf` names the object a degraded datasource run read. The install-local remedy that told an author to add a `connectorSource` now names both sources (carrier note item 7). Three tests that pinned the old "declares no connectorSource" words are updated.
- **Review items**:
  - **S1** (`datasource-window-read.ts`): on a window read in several pages, an absent high-water value reads as the window's own `lo`, and a commit never goes below `from`. One test for each.
  - **N3**: an unreadable non-NULL watermark in an over-cap answer is `watermark_not_exact`. A NULL value still means the driver did not push the bounds.
  - **N4**: `pull-refusal.ts` names the datasource pull, which now throws its type.
  - **N2** is not changed here; it is reported with a proposed dated ADR-0153 note for the spec lane.
- **Liveness** (`packages/spec/liveness/mapping.json`, `job.json`):
  - `datasourceSource`, `datasourceSource.object`, `datasourceSource.watermark` and its `field` and `start` flip `planned` → `live`, and the container's `authorWarn` is dropped;
  - the children that are still inert keep warning their authors with their own `authorWarn`: `full` (no stored position until D7), `deletePolicy` and `deletedField` (D3);
  - the live `job.pull.mapping` row loses the sentence "the binder still binds only a `connectorSource` mapping".

## Tests

- `datasource-pull.test.ts` — 14 cases on a real engine. Built-in: federated SQLite source → synced SQLite target, a second run that updates and does not duplicate. Each judgment refused with `code` + `status` + `reason`, nothing written. Under `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`: only the job's organization's rows are copied, and every source read carries the predicate; an undeclared scope is refused before any read; a walled source with no organization is refused; a shared source is read whole. Floored: a plugin driver through the floor under the cap is copied; one that pushes no bound, over the cap, is refused `sync_bounds_not_pushed` through the protocol adapter.
- `datasource-window-read.test.ts` — S1 (two cases) and N3 (one case) added; 28 cases.
- `app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts` — a datasource pull job is scheduled, run, and its degraded reason names the object; the no-source refusal names both keys.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts`'s JSDoc on `datasourceSource` still says "READ BY NOTHING YET … the liveness row is `planned`". Not edited: this slice makes no `packages/spec/src` change outside `contracts/`. Carrier: the slice that next touches that file (D4's or D3's).
- The `full` describe ("omitted ⇒ each run reads on from the position the last run committed") is true only once D7 stores the position; its liveness row stays `planned` and warns the author until then.
- N2 (the floor's refusal carries whole rows; the ADR says watermark values): the wiring reads through `protocol.findData`, which has no channel to tell the floor which field is the watermark, so narrowing it needs an engine option. Reported for a dated ADR-0153 deviation note through the spec lane.

## Verification
